title: Late Days on a Credit Balance Refund — Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Desk Reference
content:
**Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan — the refund clock.** On a refund of the credit balance left on an ended plan, the clock starts at the event that left the balance:

1. When the plan's fee ledger carries a fee credit, the late days are the calendar days from the latest fee credit to the handling date, less 21.
2. When the ledger carries no fee credit and the plan has a cancellation request, the late days are the calendar days from the latest cancellation request date to the handling date, less 21.
3. Otherwise, the late days are the calendar days from the date the plan ended to the handling date, less 21.

In every case the late days are never below zero.

| Plan records | Clock starts at | Late days |
| --- | --- | --- |
| at least one fee credit on the fee ledger | the date of the latest fee credit | days since then, less 21 |
| no fee credit; a cancellation request on file | the latest cancellation request date | days since then, less 21 |
| no fee credit; no cancellation request | the date the plan ended | days since then, less 21 |

**Hypothetical cases.**
- A plan's latest fee credit was posted 50 days before the handling date and its cancellation request 70 days before: the clock runs from the fee credit, giving 29 late days.
- A plan with no fee credit whose cancellation request is dated 40 days before the handling date: 19 late days.
- A terminated plan with neither, ended 18 days before the handling date: no late days.
